source.tradeNote: gulf_share: imports from the seven Gulf producers / all oil imports, an upper bound for oil through the strait (Yanbu and Fujairah bypass it); m: net oil imports / oil imports; countries marked mirror don't report, so their figures are their partners' 2023 records
source.weights: IMF consumer price indices by COICOP division (all items, food, housing and energy, transport; monthly; budget weights), fetched 2026-10-25; FAOSTAT consumer price indices (general and food) where the IMF has none, fetched 2026-10-25
source.fuel: 12-month log change in motor-fuel consumer prices on the 12-month log change in Brent (US$), 2009-01 to 2025-12, Newey-West errors over 12 months; range is 90%. Brent: FRED MCOILBRENTEU (Brent, monthly average, US$), fetched 2026-10-25
